info.title: Aetos.RoslynSkills.Tools
info.description: Helper commands for the roslyn-skills Claude Code plugin. One subcommand group per skill; add-diagnostic covers repository convention detection, diagnostic ID allocation, ordered resx insertion, and documentation URL resolution. Every command prints JSON.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Helper commands for the roslyn-skills plugin's skills. Every command prints JSON on stdout, including for expected failures ({"error": ..., "hint": ...} with exit code 1) and for bugs in the tool itself (the same shape plus "unexpected": true, with exit code 2).

commands.name: add-diagnostic
commands.description: Helpers for the add-diagnostic skill: repository convention detection, ID allocation, ordered resx insertion, and documentation URL resolution.

commands.name: find-conventions
commands.description: Detects the diagnostic conventions a repository already uses.

options.name: --path
options.description: Absolute path to the repository, or any directory inside it. Defaults to the working directory. [default: .]

options.name: --summary
options.description: Drop the per-project package/project/file lists, which no step reads once the project kinds and idSharing have been computed. [default: False]

commands.name: next-id
commands.description: Computes the next free diagnostic or suppression ID.

options.name: --ids-file
options.description: Absolute path to DiagnosticIds.cs or SuppressionIds.cs.

options.name: --prefix
options.description: ID prefix such as ABC. Inferred from existing IDs, band headers, or the config when omitted.

options.name: --category
options.description: Category name, resolved to a band through the file's band headers or the config.

options.name: --band
options.description: Band digit to allocate in, when the category has no header yet.

options.name: --digits
options.description: Digit count of the number. Taken from the existing IDs, else 4.

options.name: --suppression
options.description: Allocate a suppression ID (prefix + 'S' + number), which has no bands. [default: False]

commands.name: add-resx-entries
commands.description: Adds resx entries in ID order and validates the result.

options.name: --resx
options.description: Absolute path to a .resx file. Repeat the option, or pass a comma-separated list, for several files.

options.name: --entries
options.description: A JSON array of { name, value, comment? } objects, or the path to a file holding one.

options.name: --ids-file
options.description: Absolute path to the IDs file, used to sort new entries by ID value.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the value of an entry that already exists instead of skipping it. [default: False]

options.name: --validate-only
options.description: Only report on the files, without adding anything. [default: False]

commands.name: doc-url
commands.description: Resolves a rule documentation page's public URL for helpLinkUri.

options.name: --doc
options.description: The documentation file's path within the repository, such as docs/rules/ABC1001.md, because it becomes part of a URL.

options.name: --path
options.description: Any path inside the repository. Defaults to the working directory. [default: .]
